figures.rough_in: the toilet's rough-in: the distance from the finished wall to the centre of the floor drain that the toilet is made for, in inches. A product page that offers several rough-in sizes states more than one; the size of the selected option is the one that counts.
figures.flush_volume: how much water one flush uses, in gallons per flush (gpf). A dual-flush toilet states two volumes, a light flush and a full flush: read them as one spread from the smaller to the larger.
figures.flow_rate: the maximum water flow of a faucet or shower head, in gallons per minute (gpm).
figures.overall_width: the measured outside width of the vanity cabinet with its top, in inches, as given in the page's dimensions or specifications. A size class in a product name is a nominal size, not the overall width.

shopper_facts.label: rough-in measured at the house (wall to drain centre)
